requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL persist observability XNL file sinks according to the same append-only versus replace-state classification used by session persistence.

case.given: An observability trace sink writes records to `sessions/&amp;lt;sessionId&amp;gt;/trace.xnl` or a caller-provided `trace.xnl` path
case.then: The sink SHALL append one complete top-level `TraceEntry` XNL trace record per event
The sink SHALL NOT rewrite a growing root wrapper for trace history
`TraceEntry` SHALL include `traceKind` metadata to distinguish observability trace from graph trace when both producers share the tag
Single typed children such as `Payload`, `Error`, or `Value` SHALL use `()`; multiple typed children SHALL use `[]`

case.given: A SceneStore persists replay or observability XNL files in a project workspace
case.when: The store resolves its root directory
case.then: The files SHALL be placed under `.eidolon/scenes/&amp;lt;sessionId&amp;gt;/`
The store SHALL NOT create workspace-root `scenes/` data directories as normal project output

case.given: A scene store records turn or scene events
case.then: The event SHALL be appended as one complete top-level `SceneMessage` XNL element
`SceneMessage` SHALL include `version`, `sequence`, `id`, `sessionId`, and `role` metadata
Ordered `TextPart` and `ToolCall` children SHALL use `[]` even when a message currently has one text part
The manifest MAY be replace-written as a `SceneManifest` because it is bounded scene state rather than event history
The manifest SHALL NOT contain the growing event log
`SceneManifest` SHALL contain typed children such as `SystemPrompt` and `ToolDefs` using `[]`

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL 在显式启用时，把每次真实 provider request attempt 作为独立、append-only、可查询的 SQLite 诊断事实持久化，且该 sink SHALL NOT 参与或改变 live AI loop。

case.given: provider runtime 即将执行一次真实 transport attempt，包括 retry 内的 WebSocket、HTTP 或 fallback attempt
case.when: 最终 request body 已完成所有 adapter-specific 变换且即将执行 fetch 或 WebSocket send
case.then: 系统 SHALL 在每个真实发送动作前持久化恰好一条 request observation
observation SHALL 保留脱敏后的 exact request body、transport type/ordinal、source provider messages/tools 以及 session/actor/turn/provider-call/provider-attempt identity
只执行 prompt build、估算或 preflight 而未调用 provider 时 SHALL NOT 写入 request observation
WebSocket 失败后发送不同 HTTP fallback body 时 SHALL 记录同一 provider attempt 下两个有序 transport observations

case.given: runtime 已生成将要发送的 messages、tools 和 request contract
case.when: 系统复制并持久化 observation
case.then: 原 provider request 的结构、顺序、字段和值 SHALL 保持不变
启用或关闭 observation SHALL 产生相同的 provider 调用次数和输入

case.given: request 配置包含 authorization、API key、cookie、token、secret 或 connection options
case.when: 系统构造 SQLite observation 副本
case.then: 认证字段和 connection options SHALL NOT 以明文写入数据库
数据库文件 SHALL 仅允许当前用户读写

case.given: SQLite open、schema、lock、write 或 disk 操作失败
case.when: provider attempt 到达 observation port
case.then: 系统 SHALL 产生有界诊断并继续原 provider attempt
系统 SHALL NOT 因 observation 失败而取消、重试或改变 provider 结果

requirement.statement: 显式启用 provider request capture 时，系统 SHALL 以同一 attempt identity 分别持久化 send-before request plan/wire observation 与 response-after terminal outcome；SQLite sink MUST 保持 app 顶层 support effect、fail-open、append-only，且 MUST NOT 参与 planning 或改变 live loop。

case.given: logic 已生成真实 transport attempt 的 request plan 与最终 wire body
case.then: observation SHALL 显式记录 plan kind、可空 replay source、previous-id 采用或拒绝及 reason
wire body、transport 与 attempt identity SHALL 来自同一个实际发送动作

case.given: 一个 provider/transport attempt 完成、失败、中止或发生 WS→HTTP fallback
case.then: outcome SHALL 以 attempt identity 关联 request row，并记录 terminal state、实际 fallback 与 output completeness decision
`fallback_used` SHALL 表示真实发生的 fallback，而非配置意图

case.given: 旧 session 的 ledger 使用较早 schema
case.when: 顶层 support sink 打开并追加新 observation
case.then: schema SHALL 非破坏迁移并保留旧 request rows
认证字段 SHALL 继续脱敏，SQLite 失败 SHALL fail-open
core/logic SHALL NOT 存储 SQLite，terminal/organ SHALL 只绑定 port 与 lifecycle
